Pointstate Capital Lp who had been investing in Autodesk Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $30.42B market cap company. The stock increased 1.71% or $2.33 during the last trading session, reaching $138.85. About 1.54M shares traded. Autodesk, Inc. (NASDAQ:ADSK) has risen 50.18% since May 18, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 38.63% the S&P500.
Pointstate Capital Lp, which manages about $10.76 billion and $10.30B US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Altaba Inc by 2.34 million shares to 2.39M shares, valued at $166.77M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Salesforce Com Inc (Call) (NYSE:CRM) by 90,200 shares in the quarter, for a total of 210,000 shares, and has risen its stake in Loral Space & Communicatns I (NASDAQ:LORL).
